description: Ministry of Megapolis of Western Development - Approval of the Development Plan for the Seethawaka P/S Area
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with the approval of a development plan for a specific local government area (Seethawaka Pradeshiya Sabha). The notice concerns land use planning and development regulations, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land use planning and zoning changes. While it mentions a minister's name and title, the core content is about land development regulations rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
